urls.rationale: Part III - Code of Ethics for Public Officers and Employees (Ss. 112.311-112.3261) - houses F.S. 112.3215, the executive-branch lobbyist registration and compensation-reporting statute administered by the FL Commission on Ethics.

notes: Chapter 112 is partitioned into 8 parts (employment, interchange, ethics, retirement, suspension/removal, law enforcement, actuarial, firefighters). Only Part III (Code of Ethics) houses lobbying disclosure (112.3215 and related sections). Pass-3 here lands on parts (not sections); a deeper fetch on Part III is required to enumerate section leaves.
